program.name: Hold Me Up
program.subject: Bedroom stamina
program.blurb: Strong enough to hold her up and keep fucking: deadlifts, carries, grip, squats and long holds.
program.about: For the positions where you take her weight, her legs around you, and keep fucking. One day is lifting and carrying: deadlifts, farmer carries, rows and grip holds. The other is squats, wall sits and other long holds that keep your legs steady under load. Strong legs, back and grip make holding her easy, not a strain. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III makes every hold longer.
